scripts.build: rm -rf packages/core/dist apps/proof/dist && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build-proof.ts
scripts.typecheck: rm -rf packages/core/dist && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/proof/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: rm -rf packages/core/dist && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts scripts/comment-check/comment-check.test.ts
